actions.title: Send a document-coordinate tool input sample
Execute a complete stroke using the selected tool

library.description: Versioned user Brush/Eraser scalar presets. IDs are sorted, unique, below next_id and never reused after committed deletion. Missing providers may remain stored; apply validates the exact registered owner/tool.

name.description: Nonblank artist-owned name, no control characters; runtime enforces at most 512 UTF-8 bytes. Maximum 512 UTF-8 bytes; enforced by the typed preset format.

owner.description: Maximum 96 UTF-8 bytes; enforced by the typed preset format. Registered IDs use ASCII letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen.

tool_id.description: Maximum 96 UTF-8 bytes; enforced by the typed preset format. Registered IDs use ASCII letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen.

parameters.description: Complete scalar/dynamics snapshot; optional tip geometry resolves to Round/1/0. Foreground and background colors are excluded and preserved on Apply.

tip_shape.description: Analytic Round or Square tip; omitted values resolve to Round.

tip_roundness.description: Minor/major axis ratio; omitted values resolve to 1.

tip_angle.description: Fixed clockwise document degrees; omitted values resolve to 0.
